findings.title: Claim map rewrites source-specific ceilings and transfer provenance
findings.evidence: E3 is labeled transfer_source=empirical_proxy, but its bound R36-05 RESULT has transfer_source=none and claim_tier=conditional_synthetic_method_experiment; current PUBLICATION_STATUS admits only the frozen synthetic experiment. E5 is recoded C1 although its RESULT/INTERPRETATION are C0_CONDITIONAL_METHOD. E7 is C1/empirical_proxy although its RESULT has C0 conditional response/design and none; first-order kinematic response, and its current PUBLICATION_STATUS explicitly qualifies C0. E10 is empirical_proxy although its RESULT specifies EH98_NO_WIGGLE_APPROXIMATION and CONDITIONAL_MODEL_COVARIANCE. No mapping or new tier decision supports these changes.
findings.consequence: The required machine-readable claim/evidence product misclassifies a synthetic result as empirical and drops the actual external analytic transfer approximation. Downstream tier/provenance consumers cannot recover the preserved source ceilings from these fields alone; cautious report prose does not repair their contradictory metadata. This is a report transcription defect, not a failure of the underlying calculations.
findings.minimal_fix: Preserve the source-specific claim_tier and transfer_source strings for E3/E5/E7/E10, or use an explicitly conservative existing canonical equivalent while retaining the original source ceiling/provenance. In particular E3 transfer is none, E5/E7 remain C0 conditional, and E10 identifies EH98_NO_WIGGLE_APPROXIMATION. Audit the other existing claim rows for the same template substitution. Update candidate manifest/result identities after the bounded metadata repair; retain all original source files, qualifications, numerical results and historical receipts. No scientific rerun is needed.
findings.minimal_validation: Compare every revised claim row with its immutable RESULT plus later scoped PUBLICATION_STATUS; verify the new manifest/output hashes and that scientific source hashes and report numerical content did not change.

findings.title: Distinguish raw support from the normalized framework support quantity
findings.evidence: The report explicitly defines F(W)=sup<x,W>. The imported FOUNDATION_REPORT.md lines 183-203 distinguishes its constructive namespace and defines directional support utilization h_Theta(v)/h_K0(v); LOOP_C_KINEMATICS.md lines 154-156 also separates support and occupancy namespaces. The baseline report inherited the raw-support abbreviation.
findings.consequence: The displayed formula is a valid support function, but readers can confuse it with normalized F or legacy occupancy and lose the declared denominator. No displayed numerical result uses this ambiguous notation.
findings.minimal_fix: Call the displayed raw support h_C(W), or state that F here is an explicitly unnormalized support quantity distinct from normalized utilization and occupancy; preserve any source reference body/denominator when the normalized quantity is used.

findings.title: Recorded Markdown-to-TeX command omits font variables
findings.evidence: Running the recorded pandoc command externally produced TeX differing only by the three DejaVu font statements. Adding -V mainfont="DejaVu Serif" -V sansfont="DejaVu Sans" -V monofont="DejaVu Sans Mono" reproduced the delivered TeX byte-for-byte. Independent latexmk build of the delivered TeX succeeded and its extracted PDF text matches exactly.
findings.consequence: The source is buildable; the recorded generation command alone does not exactly recreate its font configuration.
findings.minimal_fix: In the successor receipt record the font variables or the actual documented font-injection step. Preserve the historical raw receipt as evidence.
